typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		BRANCH as string,
		MTSTATUS as string,
		{Originator BIC} as string,
		{Counterparty BIC} as string,
		{Counterparty Name} as string,
		{Current Status} as string,
		{Previous Status} as string,
		{Deal Number} as string,
		{Originator Reference} as string,
		{Buy Currency} as string,
		{Buy Amount} as decimal(19,2),
		{Sell Currency} as string,
		{Sell Amount} as decimal(19,2),
		{FX Rate} as decimal(19,8),
		{Value Date} as timestamp,
		{Updated Date Time} as timestamp,
		NOTES as string,
		{Fund ID} as string,
		{Fund Name} as string,
		{Deal Date} as timestamp,
		MESSAGEID as decimal(25,0),
		MESSAGETYPE as string,
		INOUTIND as string,
		CLSSTATUSCODE as string,
		CLSSUBSTATUS as string,
		COMMONREFERENCE as string,
		RELATEDREFERENCE as string,
		CLSBREFERENCE as string,
		CLSMATCHINGREFERENCE as string,
		POSBLDUPLICATE as string,
		REASON as string,
		MESSAGEREF as string,
		SETTLEMENTSESSION as string,
		XMLID as decimal(25,0),
		ALLEGED as string,
		CTRPTYSUBMTNGPTYBIC as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(Loaddate = toString(currentTimestamp())) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		MESSAGEID as string,
		FXRATE as string,
		VALUEDATE as string,
		DealNumber as string,
		INOUTIND as string,
		DEALDATE as string,
		CLSSTATUSCODE as string,
		MESSAGEREF as string,
		FUNDNAME as string,
		NOTES as string,
		BuyCurrency as string,
		PreviousStatus as string,
		Loaddate as string,
		CounterpartyBIC as string,
		REASON as string,
		ORIGINATORREFERENCE as string,
		RELATEDREFERENCE as string,
		BRANCH as string,
		BuyAmount as string,
		COUNTERPARTYNAME as string,
		CLSBREFERENCE as string,
		SellAmount as string,
		FUNDID as string,
		CurrentStatus as string,
		CLSSUBSTATUS as string,
		CLSMATCHINGREFERENCE as string,
		XMLID as string,
		SETTLEMENTSESSION as string,
		MESSAGETYPE as string,
		ALLEGED as string,
		OriginatorBIC as string,
		SellCurrency as string,
		CTRPTYSUBMTNGPTYBIC as string,
		UpdatedDateTime as string,
		COMMONREFERENCE as string,
		MTSTATUS as string,
		POSBLDUPLICATE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		MESSAGEID,
		FXRATE = {FX Rate},
		VALUEDATE = {Value Date},
		DealNumber = {Deal Number},
		INOUTIND,
		DEALDATE = {Deal Date},
		CLSSTATUSCODE,
		MESSAGEREF,
		FUNDNAME = {Fund Name},
		NOTES,
		BuyCurrency = {Buy Currency},
		PreviousStatus = {Previous Status},
		Loaddate,
		CounterpartyBIC = {Counterparty BIC},
		REASON,
		ORIGINATORREFERENCE = {Originator Reference},
		RELATEDREFERENCE,
		BRANCH,
		BuyAmount = {Buy Amount},
		COUNTERPARTYNAME = {Counterparty Name},
		CLSBREFERENCE,
		SellAmount = {Sell Amount},
		FUNDID = {Fund ID},
		CurrentStatus = {Current Status},
		CLSSUBSTATUS,
		CLSMATCHINGREFERENCE,
		XMLID,
		SETTLEMENTSESSION,
		MESSAGETYPE,
		ALLEGED,
		OriginatorBIC = {Originator BIC},
		SellCurrency = {Sell Currency},
		CTRPTYSUBMTNGPTYBIC,
		UpdatedDateTime = {Updated Date Time},
		COMMONREFERENCE,
		MTSTATUS,
		POSBLDUPLICATE),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
